## Summary

Describe the change and the user/system outcome.

## Linked work

Issue / design / ADR / implementation plan:

## Authority and compatibility

- [ ] I identified the authoritative system(s) touched by this change.
- [ ] I did not create a second source of truth or move authority accidentally.
- [ ] Save compatibility / migration impact is documented and tested, or this change does not affect persistence.
- [ ] Rendering/UI remains presentation-only unless an approved architecture decision explicitly changes that boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Observed the expected RED before implementation when behavior changed.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant browser/visual/performance gates pass.

## Risk and performance

Describe meaningful integration, determinism, allocation/hot-path, asset, or dependency risk. Write `None identified` only after checking.

## Review notes

Call out non-obvious design decisions, compatibility seams, follow-up work, or areas where reviewers should focus.
